appDownload.title: Download NoParchi for Android
appDownload.sub: High-speed scanner and offline gate verification for your staff and counters.

hero.eyebrow: Now live for parking, melas & street stalls
hero.sub: NoParchi turns any entry point into a smart QR gate — customers scan, pay, and get a WhatsApp ticket in seconds. No app, no paper, no leakage.
hero.note: No credit card needed · Setup in one afternoon
hero.step1Body: Customer points their phone camera at your branded QR — no app download.
hero.step2Body: A lightweight web page opens — pick what's needed, pay in one tap.
hero.step3Body: A verified pass arrives instantly — ready to be scanned at exit.

proof.notice: Illustrative figures and quotes — shown to preview how this section will read once NoParchi is in the field.
proof.title: What operators say
proof.q1: The counter used to be an argument every evening. Now the gate opens on a green tick and nobody debates the amount.
proof.q2: We ran eleven gates over four days of the mela. I could see every rupee from my phone without standing at any of them.
proof.q3: My boys only get the scanner. Pricing and the ledger stay with me. That was the whole reason I switched.

features.title: Built for the counter, not the boardroom
features.sub: Every feature exists to stop revenue leakage and speed up the line at the gate.
features.f1Body: Every ticket locks the instant it's scanned. A second attempt is flagged red on the spot — no double entries, no reused tickets.
features.f2Body: Every rupee collected shows up on your dashboard the second it's paid — visible to you, invisible to skimming.
features.f3Title: Staff you can trust — by design
features.f3Body: Give gatekeepers scanner-only access. Ledger and pricing stay with the owner unless you say otherwise.
features.f4Body: No app to install. Your customer already has WhatsApp — that's where their ticket shows up.
features.f5Body: Scans are queued on the device and settled when signal returns, so a basement or a crowded mela never stops the line.
features.f6Body: Parking today, a mela stall tomorrow. The same gate engine adapts to what you're selling.

how.title: Four steps. No queue.
how.s1Body: One branded QR per gate, printed once, done.
how.s2Body: Right from their phone browser, no install.
how.s4Body: Big green tick or big red flag — nothing in between.

useCases.title: Wherever there's a line and a ticket
useCases.u1Body: Scan in, pay by duration, scan out — no boom-barrier arguments.
useCases.u2Body: Entry passes, ride coupons, stall payments — all through one QR gate.
useCases.u3Body: Order, pay, get a token on WhatsApp — no cash counter chaos.

cta.title: Stop losing the count at the gate.
cta.sub: Set up your first QR gate this week — no paperwork, no upfront cost.

footer.blurb: The smart QR gate for parking, events, and street stalls across India.

scanner.cameraOnPhoneBody: On a laptop, type the code printed under the customer's QR.
scanner.cameraPermissionBody: Allow camera access to scan customer passes at the gate.
scanner.offlineBody: Paid passes are cached on this device. If the network drops, scanning keeps working and every clearance is written to storage immediately, so a used pass stays used even if the app restarts. Scans upload automatically once you are back online.

gates.intro: Every scan is recorded against the gate it happened at. Name them the way your staff say them out loud.

providers.swappable: Swappable — switching one does not affect the rest of the app.

passTypes.retireNote: Switching a type off hides it from checkout. Past passes keep their original type and price.
passTypes.name: Name

passTypes.clockNote: The clock starts when the pass is paid for, not when it is created.
passTypes.extensionPlaceholder: Leave blank for the same price ({{amount}})
passTypes.extensionNote: Leave both blank to charge the same price for the same length again. Overstay is billed in whole extensions, so extending in advance is never more expensive than being late.

checkout.title: Pay and get your pass

checkout.pendingBody: Scan this with any UPI app, or use the payment app that just opened. Then show the code below to the staff — they will activate your pass.

pass.sameAsOverstay: Extending now costs the same as the overstay would — never more.
pass.usedInstruction: This pass has been scanned at the exit and cannot be used again.
pass.overInstructionDue: Extend above, or pay the overstay to the gatekeeper on your way out.
pass.overInstruction: Extend above, or show this at the exit.
pass.validInstruction: Show this QR code to the gatekeeper on your way out.
pass.unpaidInstruction: Show this code to the staff once you have paid. They will activate it, and this page will update on its own.
pass.invalidInstruction: Please speak to the staff at the counter.
